title: rubus lejeunei subsp. emarginatus
intro: Rubus lejeunei subsp. emarginatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Emarginate Raspberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus lejeunei plant. It is a type of raspberry native to the Himalayan region, known for its medicinal properties and edible fruits. The plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. Bioactive constituents of Rubus lejeunei subsp. emarginatus include ellagic acid, salicylic acid, and other polyphenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
